item.name: Daily Priorities (F009)
item.description: Use a verified login session and a current/past priorityDate. X-Time-Zone is required. Add three rows then attempt a fourth for 409; completed rows still occupy slots. Missing/expired session gives 401; an unverified login gives 403. DELETE twice gives 404 on repeat. Refetch after each change. Concurrent race checks: ASTITVA_TEST_PRIORITIES=1 npm test in server/. Fixture cleanup targets only generated test users. Never auto-retry uncertain adds.
